name: axis-shift-by-age
label: Axis class of astigmatism (with-the-rule, against-the-rule, oblique) among astigmatic eyes by age: the primary calibration target (spec §8)

definition.classes: WTR: minus-cylinder axis within 30 deg of 180; ATR: within 30 deg of 90; oblique: otherwise (the usual convention; each source's own definition is noted where the excerpt states it)
definition.thresholdCitation: assumption: the excerpts do not state the sources' astigmatism thresholds; 0.5 D is a common screening threshold. The forward model classifies modeled eyes with this threshold.

sources.label: Primary school children, Zibo City, China
sources.citation: Exploring the prevalence and biological features of astigmatism in primary school children in Zibo City, China (PMC12657078; search excerpt, 2026-10-29): among children with astigmatism, WTR about 63%, ATR about 27%, oblique about 10%.

sources.label: Adult age bands summarized from Read, Collins & Carney's review
sources.citation: Read SA, Collins MJ, Carney LG, A review of astigmatism and its possible genesis, Clin Exp Optom 90:5-19, 2007, as summarized in Beesley & Elliott, Changes in ocular astigmatism with age: a longitudinal study, Ophthalmic Physiol Opt 2024, doi 10.1111/opo.13234 (search excerpt, 2026-10-29): WTR about 55% at ages 21-30 and about 12% over 60; ATR about 20% at 21-30 and about 57% over 60; oblique 'roughly 10-20%' and stable. Oblique is set to the remainder (25% and 31%), outside the quoted range, so only WTR and ATR are fitted from this source.

sources.label: Corneal astigmatism of cataract-surgery patients, northern China
sources.citation: Prevalence and age-related changes of corneal astigmatism in patients undergoing cataract surgery in northern China (PMC7542495; search excerpt, 2026-10-29): under 65 years WTR 49.6%, ATR 33.6%, oblique 16.8%; 65 and over WTR about 30% (the other classes not in the excerpt).
sources.useNote: Corneal astigmatism of a cataract population; the model predicts refraction and the internal (lenticular) astigmatism is not modeled. Kept for comparison.

sources.label: Corneal astigmatism of 23,239 eyes before cataract surgery, Germany
sources.citation: Hoffmann PC, Hutz WW, Analysis of biometry and prevalence data for corneal astigmatism in 23,239 eyes, J Cataract Refract Surg 36(9):1479-1485, 2010, doi 10.1016/j.jcrs.2010.02.025 (search excerpt, 2026-10-29): WTR 46.8%, ATR 34.4%, oblique 18.9%; median age 74 years; the axis was associated with age (bands not in the excerpt).
sources.useNote: Corneal, cataract population, one age band around the median age; kept for comparison.
